summary.text: Valerie Wade is the Democratic candidate for Idaho State Senate District 2 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Phil Hart (R).
Her career experience includes working as a geologist.

paragraphs.text: In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Valerie Wade said she grew up in a family of seven, holds a B.S. in Geology, and has worked as a production geologist, cost analyst and food and septic inspector, and on the Bunker Hill Superfund Site.
She said she is a 2025 NEHA Leadership Academy graduate.
Her listed priorities include keeping public lands in public hands, funding education from preschool through higher education, and supporting rural communities.
